answer_1.quote: We introduce the first Greek financial extractive summarization task... The task also includes an abstractive summarization task... These tasks evaluate models' ability to generate summaries of financial documents.
answer_1.outputs: summaries (extractive and abstractive), answers for QA

answer_2.quote: We adopt the same metrics following previous studies ... Entity F1 score is applied to numeric and textual NER tasks ... Accuracy (Acc) is used for QA and topic classification ... Rouge-1 is employed for abstractive and extractive summarization tasks.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation of selected models on Greek financial tasks. Expert native Greek speakers with deep financial and linguistic expertise compare the model-generated summaries against gold standard summaries following a rigorous, standardized annotation guideline.
answer_4.guideline: Standardized annotation guideline with specific evaluation dimensions for each summary.
